attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.intro: Lorebooks, tools and widgets that get exported along with the character.

lorebook.title: Lorebooks
lorebook.hint: Active in every chat with this character, on top of your active lorebooks. The first one is the main lorebook: exports that allow only one lorebook, like SillyTavern cards, keep that one.
lorebook.duplicateHint: Duplicate: edit a copy without changing anything else that uses this lorebook

tool.title: Tools
tool.hint: The model can use these in chats with this character, even if they are switched off in the Tools studio.
tool.duplicateHint: Duplicate: edit a copy without changing anything else that uses this tool

widget.title: Widgets
widget.hint: Run in every chat with this character, even if they are switched off in the Widgets studio.
widget.duplicateHint: Duplicate: edit a copy without changing anything else that uses this widget

characters.title: Characters
characters.empty: No characters yet — create one to get started.
characters.confirmDelete: Delete {name} and all of its chats?

characterEditor.name: Name
characterEditor.descriptionHint: The main character definition. Reaches the model through the Description node.
characterEditor.personalityHint: Traits and behaviour, placed by the Personality node.
characterEditor.scenarioHint: The situation the roleplay opens in, placed by the Scenario node.
characterEditor.systemPromptHint: Overrides the template’s system prompt for this character.
characterEditor.postHistoryHint: Placed after the chat history, closest to the model’s reply.
characterEditor.injectionHint: Fills the Character Injection node. Write '{{'template'}}' where that node’s own text should go, and read stored values like '{{'story:traits'}}'.
characterEditor.creator: Creator
characterEditor.creatorNotesHint: Notes for whoever opens this card. Never sent to the model.
characterEditor.historyHint: Edits made close together are grouped into one version. A new version starts after a period of inactivity.

lorebooks.title: Lorebooks
lorebooks.empty: No lorebooks yet — create one to start writing world knowledge.

templates.title: Templates
templates.empty: No templates yet — create one to shape how context reaches the model.
templates.name: Name

templateEditor.allSourcesUsed: Every available source node is already in this template.
templateEditor.title: Title
templateEditor.contentPlaceholder: Optional — you can edit this later
templateEditor.alwaysWrap: Always include prefix/suffix, even if all children are disabled
templateEditor.defaultsSet: {count, plural, one {# setting set to defaults.} other {# settings set to defaults.}}
templateEditor.sourceUnavailable: Source definition unavailable — settings can't be shown.
templateEditor.noSourceSettings: This source node has no settings.

tools.title: Tools
tools.builtInNote: Ships with the server and is available to every realm without an import. Read-only — make a copy to change how it behaves.
tools.alreadyForkedSuffix: of your own, which takes precedence over this one.
tools.name: Name
tools.nameHint: The identifier the model calls. Letters, digits, _ or -, up to 64.
tools.displayNameHint: Shown in the UI instead of the name. Optional.
tools.callableHint:
A tool is offered to the model on a turn.
A command is invoked by you as /name in the composer.
The same body can serve both.
tools.overridesSuffix: Delete or rename this command to get the original back.
tools.descriptionHint: Tells the model when and why to call this tool.
tools.parametersHint: Become available in the cmd namespace, e.g. '{{'cmd:name'}}'.
tools.noParameters: No parameters. The tool takes no input.
tools.resourceHint: Offer a search for this kind and store its id
tools.bodyHint: weaver-lang source. Its output is returned to the model as the tool result.
tools.select: Select a tool to edit, or create one.

modules.confirmDelete: Delete "{name}"? Anything that calls it will stop working.
modules.title: Modules
modules.nameHint: How templates reach this module: @[name.proc()] calls a proc, '{{'name:value'}}' reads a value.
modules.sourceHint: Values and procs to share with tools, lorebooks and realms while this module is enabled.
modules.select: Select a module to edit, or create one.

personas.title: Personas
personas.name: Name
personas.displayNameHint: Shown instead of the name. Leave blank to use the name.
personas.pseudonymHint: An alternate name or alias for this persona.
personas.descriptionHint: Free-form notes describing this persona. Reaches the model as '{{'persona:description'}}'.
personas.bindAria: Bind a character to this persona
personas.overridesNote: Chats with these characters use this persona instead of your active one. A character can only be bound to one persona.
personas.noneBound: No characters are bound to this persona.
personas.confirmDelete: Delete {name}? Characters bound to it go back to using your active persona.
personas.lastPersona: You need at least one persona, so this one can't be deleted.

widgets.title: Widgets
widgets.builtInNote: Ships with Lorealm and is always available. Read-only — make a copy to change it.
widgets.alreadyForkedSuffix: of your own, which replaces this one while it's enabled.
widgets.name: Name
widgets.placementAttachment: Attachment — the model places it inline
widgets.directiveHint: A weaver-formatted prompt sent to the model. Describes how the model should maintain this
widgets.directivePlaceholder: When affection changes, update relationship:'{{'char:name'}}'.affection using the set_var tool.
widgets.renderHintAttachment: What the model reads in place of this attachment. Props arrive as '{{'props:name'}}'. Leave empty to show [widget: id].
widgets.renderHintWidget: What the model reads for this widget, inserted wherever the node exists. Reads state as '{{'namespace:name'}}'.
widgets.tools: Tools — made available to the model whenever this widget is active. Imported into a realm with the widget; no separate tool import needed.
widgets.select: Select a widget to edit, or create one.
